title: Escondite Sur | KEY.co
description_expanded: Escondite Sur is a refined coastal retreat along scenic 30A in Santa Rosa Beach, offering an elevated blend of luxury, comfort, and effortless beachside living. Just a short stroll from the sugar-white sands and emerald Gulf waters, this stunning home welcomes guests with light-filled interiors, floor-to-ceiling windows, and elegant wood flooring throughout. The expansive open-concept living space creates the perfect setting for gathering, featuring a cozy fireplace, a chef-inspired kitchen with sleek modern appliances and marble countertops, and a spacious dining area ideal for shared meals and memorable evenings. Thoughtful touches like a butler’s pantry, private elevator, and a lively billiards room with direct pool access add both convenience and entertainment to every stay. Outdoor living shines across four levels of beautifully designed spaces. A resort-style private heated pool, soothing hot tub, and fully equipped outdoor kitchen create a private oasis perfect for relaxing or entertaining under the coastal sky. Multiple balconies and folding glass doors invite the Gulf breeze inside, while the rooftop observation deck showcases breathtaking views of the coastline and unforgettable sunsets. With six adult bikes, a six-seater golf cart, and pet-friendly accommodations, every detail has been carefully curated to make exploring Santa Rosa Beach effortless. Blending modern elegance with laid-back coastal charm, Escondite Sur offers an exceptional setting for unforgettable gatherings with family and friends.
